prompt: A photorealistic high-angle wide frame of a cheap basement gym, taken from a lens fixed up in a corner of the ceiling and tilted steeply down, so the two men are small and seen from above. Brandon lies on his back on a padded bench in the lower centre, his brows lifted, his eyelids soft and wide, the corners of his mouth up in a trusting half-smile, his eyes aimed up at Gary; a heavily loaded barbell rests above his chest on the rack. Gary stands at the head of the bench, bending a little, both hands under the bar, brows level and his eyes aimed down at Brandon. The floor is black rubber matting, a rack of dumbbells and a rolled yoga mat sit against a breeze-block wall, and the light is two buzzing strip tubes plus a dim bulb that leave the corners murky. The colour is washed out with a faint green cast, strong compression smear and night-mode grain. No writing anywhere in frame. Thanks.
